primary_weighting: equal-surface: arithmetic mean of the three per-surface mean squared residuals
bounds_rationale: nonnegative native Amber barrier amplitudes with a 2 kcal/mol per-instance ceiling; mapped multiplicities make this a conservative profile-scale bound

regularization.form: 0.01 * sum(((k-k_baseline)/0.5)^2) per independently optimized surface block
regularization.purpose: parsimonious baseline movement and protection against opposing correlated CHI coefficients

optimizer.algorithm: scipy.optimize.minimize L-BFGS-B, independently on the three exactly separable two-parameter surface blocks

low_energy_weight_function: w=1 for E<=1; w=0.5*(1+cos(pi*(E-1)/9)) for 1<E<10; w=0 for E>=10 kcal/mol
prmtop_readback_tolerance_basis: Amber prmtop DIHEDRAL_FORCE_CONSTANT uses E16.8 decimal serialization
